title: Chusky has been upgraded
bullets: Added durable autonomous missions for concrete outcomes, with dependency-aware steps, bounded budgets, retries, restart-safe execution, server-side closeout, and live provider outcome verification.

Owner-scoped image transfers work from conversation, generated, or saved images through exact connected-app actions; publish/send completion is reported only after the provider confirms that exact action succeeded.
Missions execute exact owner-approved compensation actions, verify expected provider state by fresh read-back, and persist linked receipts across Telegram, CLI, SDK/API, dashboard, and MCP.
